tasks.name: count-lines
tasks.prompt: Count the total lines of Rust code in crates/claudes/src/. Use Glob to find .rs files then Read a few of them. Report the line counts.

tasks.name: find-todos
tasks.prompt: Search the codebase for any TODO or FIXME comments in Rust files under crates/. Use Grep to search. List what you find.

tasks.name: analyze-deps
tasks.prompt: Read Cargo.toml files for all crates in this workspace. List the external dependencies for each crate. Use Glob to find Cargo.toml files, then Read them.
